specs.source_title: Bambu PA6-CF Technical Data Sheet V3.0
specs.locator: p.1, Basic Info
specs.quote: Bambu PA6-CF is a carbon fiber reinforced PA6 (Nylon 6) filament.

specs.source_title: Bambu PA6-CF Technical Data Sheet V3.0
specs.locator: p.1, Specifications › Diameter
specs.note: Agrees with the store page (Product Features › bullet 5: 'Diameter: 1.75mm +/- 0.03mm').

specs.source_title: Bambu PA6-CF Technical Data Sheet V3.0
specs.locator: p.1, Specifications › Net Filament Weight
specs.note: The TDS names one net weight (1 kg); scoped to the store's '1kg' Size value, where it agrees with the store page (1000 g). The '0.5kg' value has no TDS weight.

specs.source_title: Bambu PA6-CF Technical Data Sheet V3.0
specs.locator: p.2, Mechanical Properties › Tensile Strength (X-Y)
specs.test_condition: printed specimen, X-Y; specimens annealed and dried at 80 °C for 12 h before testing
specs.note: Z direction: 48 ± 6 MPa (no registry key for the Z value).

specs.source_title: Bambu PA6-CF Technical Data Sheet V3.0
specs.locator: p.2, Mechanical Properties › Breaking Elongation Rate (X-Y)
specs.test_condition: printed specimen, X-Y; specimens annealed and dried at 80 °C for 12 h before testing
specs.note: Z direction: 3.7 ± 0.8 % (no registry key for the Z value).

specs.source_title: Bambu PA6-CF Technical Data Sheet V3.0
specs.locator: p.2, Mechanical Properties › Bending Strength (X-Y)
specs.test_condition: printed specimen, X-Y; specimens annealed and dried at 80 °C for 12 h before testing
specs.note: Z direction: 80 ± 7 MPa. The wiki CF guide gives 151 MPa dry and 95 MPa humid (X-Y).

specs.source_title: Bambu PA6-CF Technical Data Sheet V3.0
specs.locator: p.2, Mechanical Properties › Bending Modulus (X-Y)
specs.test_condition: printed specimen, X-Y; specimens annealed and dried at 80 °C for 12 h before testing
specs.note: Z direction: 2240 ± 220 MPa. The wiki CF guide gives 5460 MPa dry and 3560 MPa humid (X-Y).

specs.source_title: Bambu PA6-CF Technical Data Sheet V3.0
specs.locator: p.2, Mechanical Properties › Impact Strength (X-Y)
specs.quote: Impact Strength (X-Y) ISO 179, GB/T 1043 40.3 ± 2.5 kJ/m²; 13.4 ± 1.7 kJ/m² （notched）
specs.test_condition: printed specimen, X-Y; specimens annealed and dried at 80 °C for 12 h before testing; unnotched (the notched X-Y value 13.4 ± 1.7 kJ/m² is listed beside it)
specs.note: Z direction: 15.5 ± 1.7 kJ/m². The wiki CF guide also gives 40.3 kJ/m² as Impact Strength - XY.

specs.source_title: Bambu PA6-CF Technical Data Sheet V3.0
specs.locator: p.2, Physical Properties › Heat Deflection Temperature (0.45 MPa)
specs.note: The TDS also gives 164 °C at 1.8 MPa (ISO 75); one row per key and scope, the 0.45 MPa value is the one the wiki CF guide quotes.

specs.locator: p.1, Recommended Printing Settings › Drying Settings before Printing
specs.quote: Drying Settings before Printing Blast Drying Oven: 80 °C, 8 - 12 h
specs.note: Alternative on the same row: X1 Series printer heatbed 90 - 100 °C, 12 h. The wiki drying table gives 75-85 °C forced-air oven for PA6-CF/GF; the wiki CF guide gives 80 °C, 8–12 h (convection oven).

specs.source_title: Bambu PA6-CF Technical Data Sheet V3.0
specs.locator: p.1, Recommended Printing Settings › Drying Settings before Printing
specs.quote: Drying Settings before Printing Blast Drying Oven: 80 °C, 8 - 12 h
specs.test_condition: blast drying oven at 80 °C, before printing
specs.note: Alternative on the same row: X1 Series printer heatbed, 12 h. The wiki drying table and CF guide also give 8-12 h for the oven.
